runs.title: FIX CHECK — the signage boards are gone. Does the street stay unlettered?
verdicts: PASS — neighbours with blank fascias and no readable words anywhere
FAIL — any shopfront lettering, garbled or legible

runs.title: FIX CHECK — roof form is now locked, and Outward forbids the vertical stack.
verdicts: PASS — flat overhanging roof preserved AND layers offset sideways
FAIL — a pitched roof, or layers stacked one directly above another

runs.title: FIX CHECK — the camera is now audited FIRST. Does the viewpoint hold?
verdicts: PASS — same camera, same window, same panes, room emptied
FAIL — the view shifts, or the window changes size or pane count

runs.title: BLAST-RADIUS CHECK — Stage inherited the camera rewrite on another tool’s evidence.
verdicts: PASS — furnished from the identical camera, shell untouched
FAIL — the camera moves, or the rewrite has broken staging

settings.element: the beige fabric sofa inside the red rectangle
settings.replacement: a dark green velvet three-seater sofa

runs.title: THE RED BOX. Instruction, or something to faithfully redraw?
verdicts: PASS — the sofa is swapped and NO red rectangle appears in the output
FAIL — the red box is reproduced in the output, or the edit is ignored, or something outside the box changed

runs.title: Does an upscale resolve detail, or hallucinate detail that was never there?
verdicts: PASS — the same drawing, cleaner, with nothing added
FAIL — invented linework, or a redesigned drawing
